headline: NZX 50 at record as Serko rallies on clear step up
summary: New Zealand's NZX 50 index reached a record and outperformed most of Asia. Travel software developer Serko led gains after upgrading its revenue guidance and lifting free cash flow.
why: The NZX 50 is New Zealand's benchmark index of leading listed companies, so its moves reflect the wider local equity market.
